How billing works
  • Students: no card needed, free as long as you want.
  • Premium: billed monthly or yearly through the App Store or Google Play. Cancel anytime in your store settings.
  • Schools: annual invoice based on enrolled students, with tiers by institution size.
  • Paid pilot: 3 months with one cohort before a full licence.

Launch prices are proposals to be validated with students and institutions.
